Valuation Lab · 简体中文 · Full v2 research (March 31 origin)

ARM · 2026-06-30

June 30, 2026 is the capital and discount origin, taken from the Q1 FY2027 6-K filed July 29, 2026; information extends to October 20, 2026. The first cash flow is the nine months July 2026–March 2027: full-year FY2027 research less reported Q1 revenue, operating income and investment, discounted 0.75 years. Nine further FY2028–36 cash flows use year-end discounting; FY2037 is terminal. This is a restated-date conditional appraisal, neither a historical backtest nor an October 20 current valuation. Current value, target, upside and ranking gates remain false even if a quote is entered.

Arm monetizes processor architecture and IP through licenses and per-chip royalties. Moving into production silicon creates a separate capital, inventory and margin model. Conditional bear/base/bull values are $8.8331/$26.1462/$63.7177 per ADS at the June 30, 2026 origin, with about 74%/78%/83% of enterprise value in terminal cash flows. No probabilities, current stock quote, upside or recommendation is supplied.

Opening stub (July 2026–March 2027): full-year FY2027 research revenue less reported Q1 royalty $715m and license $574m; full-year EBIT less reported Q1 operating income $91m; full-year net productive investment less reported Q1 net capex $133m (PPE $197m + intangibles $11m − D&A $75m); full-year working-capital investment less the reported Q1 change of $-124m in receivables, contract assets and contract liabilities. Q1 cash flows are already in June 30 cash and are not valued again. Tax applies to stub EBIT.

June 30 cash $3,058m plus short-term investments $830m ($3,888m) minus finance leases $70m, existing EDA liabilities $148m ($56m current/$92m noncurrent), DreamBig reserve $265m and minimum operating cash $257.8m yields $3,147.2m. The 6-K reports only the $21m current finance lease; the noncurrent portion sits inside $49m of other non-current liabilities, so $70m is a conservative upper bound, not the reported total. Minimum operating cash is 5% of trailing revenue $5,156m. All $589m equity investments receive zero bridge value, including $290m publicly listed. Operating leases are not separately deducted because rent remains expensed.

June 30 ordinary shares are 1,068m as filed, rounded to the nearest million; no exact June count is filed, so precision is about ±0.5m (±0.05%). One ADS represents one ordinary share. This is neither the quarterly diluted average of 1,078m nor a market-cap proxy. The v2 March 31 exact count was 1,064,055,252. June Omnibus awards rose to about 24m; ungranted PSUs are excluded. June unrecognized Omnibus compensation is $3,621.9m over 1.6 years. Plan headroom is not issued dilution.

The June-quarter 6-K says DreamBig closed July 1, 2026 for about $265m cash, one day after the June 30 origin. The bridge reserves nominal $265m at June 30 without discounting. This is a conservative analyst reserve, not exact transaction present value. Acquired cash/liabilities and final adjustments are not separately modeled, are not charged again as forecast investment, and receive no independent synergy value.

Baseline margins charge cash-equivalent economic SBC and expense R&D, with fixed June 30 shares. This replacement-compensation convention is not exact legal allocation among shares and awards, or a claim of no real future dilution. Economic margin shocks of −5pp/−10pp/+5pp and a separate 19m extra-share denominator expose risk. The share diagnostic may overlap already charged compensation, omits ungranted PSUs and is not a maximum dilution bound. Precise claims require grant-level fair value/vesting. Treasury is economic replacement cash, not a GAAP cash forecast.

ARM · 2026-06-30

资本与折现起点为 2026 年六月三十日，取自 2026 年七月二十九日提交的 2027 财年第一季 6-K；信息截至十月二十日。首个现金流为 2026 年七月至 2027 年三月九个月：2027 财年全年研究假设减去已报告第一季收入、营业利润及投资，折现 0.75 年。其后 2028–2036 九个财年按年末折现，2037 为终值年。这是带后续信息的指定日期条件估值，不是历史回测或十月二十日当前估值。即使输入股价，当前估值、目标价、上涨空间及排名资格仍关闭。

Arm 通过处理器架构及设计授权、逐芯片版税变现。进入量产芯片业务会引入独立的资本、库存与利润模型。以 2026 年六月三十日为起点，有条件熊／基准／牛情景为每 ADS 8.8331／26.1462／63.7177 美元，终值约占企业价值 74%／78%／83%。没有赋予概率、引用当前股价、计算上涨空间或提出投资建议。

期初期间（2026 年七月至 2027 年三月）：2027 财年全年研究收入减已报告第一季版税 715 及授权 574；全年营业利润减第一季营业利润 91；全年净生产性投资减第一季净资本开支 133（PPE 197＋无形资产 11－折旧摊销 75）；全年营运资本投资减第一季应收、合同资产及合同负债变动 -124。第一季现金流已包含于六月三十日现金，不再重复估值。税款按期间营业利润计算。

六月三十日现金 3,058 加短期投资 830（合计 3,888），减融资租赁 70、既有 EDA 义务 148（流动 56／非流动 92）、DreamBig 预留 265 及最低经营现金 257.8，桥接净额 3,147.2 百万美元。6-K 仅单列流动融资租赁 21；非流动部分含在其他非流动负债 49 内，因此 70 为保守上限，并非已报告合计。最低经营现金为过去十二个月收入 5,156 的 5%。全部股权投资 589（含上市持股 290）在桥接中计零。经营租赁不另扣，因为租金仍费用化。

六月三十日普通股按申报为 1,068 百万股，四舍五入至百万；未申报六月精确股数，精度约 ±0.5 百万（±0.05%）。每份 ADS 代表一股普通股。这不同于季度稀释平均 1,078 百万，也非市值代理。v2 三月三十一日精确股数为 1,064,055,252。六月 Omnibus 奖励约 24 百万，未定授予日 PSU 不含在内。六月未确认 Omnibus 薪酬 3,621.9／1.6 年。计划额度不是已发行稀释。

六月季度 6-K 称 DreamBig 于 2026 年七月一日、即六月三十日起点次日完成，现金价约 265 百万美元。桥接在六月三十日预留名义金额 265，不折现。这是保守分析预留，不是精确交易现值。未分别建模被收购现金／负债及最终调整，不在未来投资重复扣除，也不另加协同价值。

基准利润率扣除现金等价经济股权薪酬，研发费用化，股数固定为六月三十日数。这是替代薪酬约定，不是股份与奖励的精确法律分配，也不声称现实中无未来稀释。经济利润率 −5／−10／+5 个百分点及另加 19 百万股分母诊断展示风险。股数诊断可能与已扣薪酬重叠、遗漏未定授予 PSU，不能视为最大稀释界限。精确请求权需逐笔授予估值／归属模型；资金模型是经济替代现金，而非 GAAP 现金预测。
